ideas.pitch: A practice sandbox built specifically for preparing for blind coding challenges, featuring audio feedback for syntax errors without revealing visual text.
ideas.title: BlindType IDE
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets the exact niche of the event's Blind Coding round, giving students a tool to train for the competition format itself.

ideas.pitch: A real-time visualizer for head-to-head DSA problem solving that tracks AST diffs and execution traces during live duels.
ideas.title: Algorunner Live
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly enhances the live competitive programming format of the DSA Battle with unique observability tools.

ideas.pitch: An IDE extension that trains developers to rely purely on syntax memory by progressively obfuscating lines of code as typing speed increases.
ideas.title: MemoryScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the fundamentals-first, high-pressure memory test ethos of the blind coding challenge.

ideas.pitch: An automated sparring partner that generates adversarial test cases for data structure implementations in real time during head-to-head algorithm battles.
ideas.title: DSADealer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a core friction point in competitive programming practice by dynamically stressing code against edge cases.

ideas.pitch: A flashcard and muscle-memory training game for standard library functions and boilerplate code needed in blind coding competitions.
ideas.title: SyntaxRecall
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides tangible utility for the first and second-year students participating in the foundational blind coding track.
